scope.environment: c6i.metal Ice Lake research profile with recorded CPU/kernel/SMT/placement configuration; not any machine with the same product name

order: scope.json for case membership and calibration
sensitivity.json for unchanged signals, numeric obligations and deadlines
precedence.historical_contracts: Hash-bound execution inputs only. No blanket inheritance of superseded other17cases, creation status, execution queue, partial-kernel or deployment statements.
precedence.creation_state: Non-normative facts at the time the predecessor was created. Never current execution status or adoption authority.
precedence.execution_status: The immutable checkpoint and this follow-up receipt describe completed stages; neither authorizes a new execution.
precedence.conflict: Reject unexplained normative contradictions rather than choose a convenient contract.

entry.measurement_claim_identity: Exact measured source, native ELF, analysis runtime and per-stage live identity from the checkpoint. Published formatting is inspectable correspondence, not automatically physically qualified.
excluded: scripts/ci matrix admission of the HMAC-only research entry

deadline_ownership.absolute_acquisition_cutoff: External controller binds a fixed finite plan and installs schedule.installed(cutoff) before ordinary.execute or run_live; this precedes live_runtime.installed. Calling ordinary.py alone does not prove the external lifecycle.
deadline_ownership.independent_stop_and_recovery: External controller/guard responsibility; owned-process and encrypted transport components alone do not certify cloud read-back, cleanup or authenticated full recovery.

evidence.inheritance: SIX-P1/P2 remain six-case predecessor and diagnostic-artifact results; COMPARE is the separate legacy comparison diagnostic; I21 is ordinary integration. No relabeling across stages.

sensitivity_limits.F1_F6: Fixed 16-operation class-dependent shift with diagnostic wrapper/base 32-operation work on both classes; eligible witness in crops1-100 by final look. Fixed combinations were each measured once per compiler/stage; no repetition-based power guarantee.
sensitivity_limits.ordinary_artifact: No in-provider injected positive signal in the measured ordinary provider binary. Separate synthetic controls and diagnostic fixtures do not prove equivalent ordinary-artifact weak-signal power.
claim_not_made: validity of Welch approximation for arbitrary sampled distributions
operational failure rate at most 1 percent

replaced_original_detections: Keep original detections and role separately, including original-only crop detections in nondetection roles. No OR gate. In this follow-up report identify whether any such detection was removed by replacement; historical detections remain open.
